title: Understanding Bootstrap Sampling
text: Bootstrap sampling involves taking random samples with replacement from a dataset. This means each sample can have repeated entries from the original dataset. Consider how this might affect the size of your sample.

title: Percentile Calculation
text: To calculate the upper percentile, think about the range of percentiles from $$0$$ to $$100$$. The upper percentile is often used to find the boundary above which a certain percentage of data falls.

title: Choosing the Upper Percentile
text: Which percentile would you choose to represent the upper boundary of a 95% confidence interval?
